title: The Between Awakens
body:
**SEIZURE WARNING DUE TO INBUILT SHADERS**

This is not the world you once knew...

The between awakens is a extremely large combat and exploration oriented content mod adding ~600+- items ,adding over double the amount of mobs, and adding several bosses. The between awakens adds several new Dimensions, Bosses ,Biomes, Structures, Plants and other things. 

Revamps & Overhauls many vanilla biomes, structures, worldgen, and generation features.

Hard difficulty now impacts the game far more

- Milk can no longer be used to remove potion effects

- Pendants remove corruption slower

- Some foes gain extra abilities & have strengthened attacks



This mod alters the game in places you may not expect.

~~In addition to the between awakens' s large amount of content there is an optional and semi-important lore-wise expansion ; Liminus ; they were not gods~~ [ Not yet brought to modrinth ]



Allowed to be used in modpacks however not advised due to how extensively it changes the game ; meant to be used as the singular content mod in a pack.


*While 1.0.0-1.1.0 version development relied on "Mcreator", 1.3.0+ has been revamped almost entirely with far better code and has decreased the performance impact roughly 50x (Down to an average of 0.25% to 0.6% performance impact) while increasing the functionality of all features ; The cleansing continues however.
